thag1.120:1.1: Pañca kkhandhā pariññātā tiṭṭhanti chinnamūlakā; dukkhakkhayo anuppatto, patto me āsavakkhayo 'ti. || || Isidatto thero. Dvādasamo vaggo.
thag1.120:2.0: tatr' uddānaṃ bhavati: Jento ca Vacchagotto ca Vaccho ca Vanapavhayo Adhimutto Mahānāmo Pārāpariyo Yaso pi ca Kimbilo Vajjiputto ca Isidatto mahāyaso 'ti. | vīsuttarasataṃ therā
thag1.120:3.0: katakiccā anāsavā Ekake 'va nipātamhi susaṃgītā mahesibhīti. |
